decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Oval cubby entrance is now visibly open behind its original dark trim.

rear.note: Rear and side panels still enclose the cubby below the perch.

detail.note: Entrance shows real wall thickness and a recessed interior surface.

underside.note: Cubby floor remains enclosed above the original tower base.

clay.note: The dark hollow entrance distinguishes the cubby from the former solid block.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: The large table leg now clears the smaller white tabletop.

rear.note: Staggered leg arrangement retains both nested tables inside the combined footprint.

detail.note: Former protruding short leg above the lower top is gone; its pin follows the moved leg.

underside.note: Both tables retain four supports with visible clearance between the moved leg and lower top.

clay.note: Nested top overlap remains readable without the intersecting leg.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Seat seam now follows the white cushion continuously.

rear.note: Back pad and arm supports remain connected to the original frame.

detail.note: Fine light welt stays seated rather than breaking across the pad edge.

underside.note: Caster star and under-seat adjustment structure remain unchanged.

clay.note: Continuous cushion perimeter retains the chair proportions and soft seat crown.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Ceramic pedestal and tank transitions are smoother beneath the recessed bowl.

rear.note: Rear support and cistern bridge remain connected with softened profiles.

detail.note: Bowl opening and seat hinge details remain visible above the reshaped body.

underside.note: Closed foot supports the ceramic body without the former sharp box corners.

clay.note: Rounded ceramic sections retain the compact toilet envelope and open bowl.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Opal globe now has a smooth continuous surface above the brass arm.

rear.note: Rear globe no longer shows the former horizontal faceting bands.

detail.note: Soft diffuse shading is continuous across the rounded glass.

underside.note: Lower hemisphere remains smooth where the arm enters the globe.

clay.note: Closed round diffuser retains the original oval proportions and wall mount.

front.note: Green pad now has continuous seated white piping around its perimeter.

rear.note: Rear welt follows the cushion edge without floating loops.

detail.note: Small fabric undulations remain but trim stays attached to the cover.

underside.note: Metal legs and dark seat pan support the unchanged padded footprint.

clay.note: Connected perimeter trim replaces the broken raised seam segments.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Canopy has smoother scalloped edges and restrained curved cloth panels.

rear.note: Offset mast, canopy carriage and ballast remain connected.

detail.note: Fine canvas grain follows the curved panel surface beneath the vent cap.

underside.note: Existing radial ribs and stretchers remain visible below the closed thin cloth shell.
